target.statement: Average silhouette coefficient of approximately 0.50 for the k=4 K-means electrofacies solution on Well C wireline logs
target.dataset: Well C wireline logs, offshore Keta Basin (GR, RHOZ, NPHI, DT, PEFZ, AHT60; ~11,195 samples)

compute.basis: K-means on ~11k samples x 6 features is trivial on CPU; the only real cost is obtaining the proprietary Well C logs, which are not released.

blockers: Well C wireline log data are proprietary/not publicly released
No code or data links in the paper
Exact preprocessing (washout removal, outlier screening) cannot be replicated without raw logs
title: Unsupervised Electrofacies Classification and Porosity Characterization in the Offshore Keta Basin Using Wireline Logs
